id.description: The ID of the E2E key.

name.description: The name of the E2E key.

algorithm.description: Protocol between mobile SDK and the Server. Possible values `X25519`|`SECT233K1`

description.description: The description of the E2E key.

createdBy.description: The user ID (`userId`) of the creator of the E2E key.

created.description:
The timestamp when the E2E key was created.

**Format**: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

sha256Fingerprint.description: The SHA256 hash of the E2E key certificate.

publicKey.description: The E2E key certificate, which has been Base64 encoded.

state.description: The E2E key state, can be either `ENABLED` or `DISABLED`
